shiny/s-0bfc44d8.jpg.note: MECHANISM CORRECTED (33v36). NOT split-by-glare: 13/13 vetted beads have the bright specular stripe INSIDE the mask. The mask loses the SHADOWED side — measured twice independently: 36% of magenta bead material (37855 px, 32 components median 1082px) falls OUTSIDE the mask, because shadowed bead surface is luminance-dark with modest chroma and trips colorDist shadow-damping. Ellipse reunification was built and honestly fired ZERO times: every measured inter-fragment gap is DARK (-0.30..-0.70), so there is no bright specular gap to merge across and merging would cross real contact seams. Fix belongs at segmentation (recover the dark half), in flight. | ATTEMPTED AND DISQUALIFIED (measured, not shipped): global hueAware fixes the mask (36.5%->2.3% lost) but costs counts everywhere — s-0bfc 33->28, s-eb 37->34, r-7ff7fd99 19->12, r-295482c1 19->28. Shadow-gate hue variants: same corpus damage. Adjacency rescue: BROKE advil-2/3 (30->31). ROOT OF THE IMPASSE: the mask loss is LOAD-BEARING — s-eb90778f's perfect 37 comes entirely from the stamp arbiter keying on the shredded mask (stamp:false gives 31), and ONE dilation step drops it 37->31, chaotically not monotonically. UPPER BOUND: even a perfect magenta mask implies only 34 beads (truth 36) — fixing segmentation alone cannot deliver the count. Any real fix must re-derive the arbiter's shiny-path signature in the same change.

lined/lined-503b3041.jpg.note: ROOT CAUSE FOUND (was mis-attributed to ruled-line bridging): the fused cluster took the deep-pile seeding branch, whose premise "each pill rises to its own DT peak" is FALSE for a flat sheet — 81428px produced only 16 strict-max seed pixels, so the watershed could not split it and the count came from area estimation. Counts unchanged (18/18/21) — the remaining gap is splitting accuracy inside the reseeded cluster.
